description: FLOAT-INVERSION BOUNDARY: execution_health.failure_recurrence raw=0.8 inverts to 1.0-0.8=0.19999999999999996 in IEEE-754 on BOTH runtimes — just below CRITICAL_THRESHOLD (0.2), not exactly on it. So tier 2 DOES block this dim (strict `<` is satisfied by the rounding error). permission=DENY, execution_mode=RECOVERY, one block_mask entry for failure_recurrence, no deadlock. Pins that the 1.0-raw inversion is bit-identical across TS/Python.
